# Motion

## Description
What moves on the page and how. Three things: the install box lifts on hover, its icon cross-fades after a copy, and the hero graph drifts.

## Tokens
| Token | Value | Role | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--motion-micro` | `.12s ease` | hover lift of the install box: `transform` and `box-shadow` | InstallButton |
| `--motion-swap` | `.15s` | copy icon to check mark: `opacity` | InstallButton |

## Usage
Each transition names its properties. Nothing uses `transition: all`.

Anchor links scroll smoothly (`scroll-behavior: smooth` on `html`).

The hero graph is a script loop, not a CSS animation. It pauses when the canvas is out of view.

## Accessibility
Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the install box changes with no transition, anchor links jump with no smooth scroll, and the hero graph draws one still frame. The icon cross-fade stays, since nothing moves. Every capture in `.design-system/review/` was taken with reduced motion on and reports no running animation (`reducedMotion: true`, `motion: []` in each `.probe.json`).

## Not tokens
- The hero graph's drift (10px around each node, speeds .25 to .75) is set in `components/hero-graph.tsx`.
- The 1.6 seconds the copied state lasts is a timer in `components/install-button.tsx`.
